stops.note: to ensnare, to catch, from de- (down) and capere (to take)
stops.meaning: to ensnare, to catch by trickery

stops.note: carried into French for misleading someone through trickery
settled as the English word for making someone believe something untrue
stops.meaning: to make someone believe something untrue

current_meaning: to deliberately cause someone to believe something that is not true
